# v3.0.0 — Module 3: Sourcing Strategy, Product Design, and Supplier Execution

## Module 3 — Sourcing Strategy, Product Design, and Supplier Execution

- Added four complete sections covering sourcing alignment and total cost, category strategy and supply-base design, product design for supply chain, and supplier selection through procurement execution.
- Added 35 substantive topic lessons and 82 standardized knowledge checks with answer rationales.
- Added 35 original, accessible SVG decision workflows with explicit multiline text, tested at normal and narrow display widths.
- Added eight fictional datasets, worked calculations, and a sourcing and procurement formula reference.
- Added the Rivermark Climate Systems integrated sourcing-and-design capstone and solution guide.
- Extended repository navigation, glossary, learning paths, asset guidance, citation metadata, and quality controls across Modules 1–3.
- Strengthened visual validation and topic-specific content safeguards.
